name: Henshin Ring
source:
Fiz and Aria are two female bounty hunters. They carelessly accepted a dangerous beast extermination quest that they need now to fulfill.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]

菲茲和艾莉亞是兩名女性賞金獵人。她們一時大意，接下討伐危險魔獸的任務，如今不得不設法完成委託。
